description: This file is a test script for verifying rebase behavior in git when on-disk files are broken or contain specific anomalies. It sets up conflicting branches, manipulates author script files, and checks for proper failure modes during rebase operations.

methods.name: create_conflict
methods.description: Creates a rebase conflict scenario by rewinding to a branch and attempting a rebase that is expected to fail.

methods.name: check_resolve_fails
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a conflict by modifying 'file' and expects the rebase continue step to fail.
